verdict.rationale: x402 gives agents an end-to-end pay-and-receive flow: a 402 price quote, an agent-signed payment from an agentic wallet, Facilitator verification and onchain settlement, and the resource returned with settlement confirmation (supp-1, supp-7, docs-11). However, it is designed for per-request payment "without checkout pages" rather than a merchant checkout-session and order model. Checkout sessions appear only in a single thin integration line about agents authorizing Payment Acceptance sessions (docs-13). The payment credential is the agent's own wallet signature, or signed escrow limits under batch settlement (supp-10), rather than a scoped, user-delegated credential. Missing for 10: a documented checkout-session lifecycle, a user-to-agent delegated payment credential with spend scoping, order creation and confirmation semantics beyond resource delivery, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full agent checkout.
